identity.name: AVAIRA
identity.archetype: The Vigilant Guardian — institutional trust infrastructure
identity.mission: Enforce absolute control over AI execution with cryptographic precision.
identity.emotional_tone: Composed, exact, credible. Institutional confidence without theatre.

two_surfaces.marketing: Light. White canvas, hairline dividers, generous whitespace, indigo calls to action, pastel glows. Sells the protocol.
two_surfaces.console: Dark. Blueprint-tinted neutrals, dense telemetry, mono data, same indigo accent. Runs the protocol.

identity.target_audience: Blockchain architects, security engineers, DeFi operators, underwriters

design_principles: Density is Information: don't hide data behind clicks. Show the pulse of the network.
Visibility is Trust: visualise the invisible (signatures, hash validations).
Enforcement over decoration: the UI states what the contracts will do, not what might happen.
One system, two surfaces: the same tokens serve the light site and the dark console — no per-component theming.

tokens.storage: Space-separated RGB channels in CSS variables so Tailwind opacity modifiers keep working: `rgb(var(--accent) / <alpha-value>)`.

colors.rule: Red means danger only — frozen agents, slashed collateral, blocked intents, destructive actions. Everything else (navigation, primary buttons, links, focus rings, charts) uses the indigo accent.

grade_mapping.note: Both Avaira Score ladders are mapped in lib/palette.js: A+ … D (core/reputation.py) and AAA … CCC (registry UI).

typography.family_mono: JetBrains Mono (machine data only: addresses, hashes, amounts, numeric columns, uppercase micro-labels)
typography.case: Sentence case for headings, buttons and labels. Uppercase is reserved for small tracked-out mono micro-labels (nav group headings, table headers).

layout_strategy.rhythm: Marketing sections use .mk-section with 1px hairline separators and 5.5rem vertical padding; console pages use .page-shell with a hairline .page-header.
layout_strategy.border_radius: One --radius token (0.625rem) for every card, button, input and table in both surfaces.
layout_strategy.notes: Containment is 1px hairlines, not heavy borders or glow. Whitespace carries hierarchy on the marketing surface; density and mono alignment carry it in the console.

component_styling.card_console: .cyber-card — surface-card at 72% opacity, 1px hairline, --shadow-panel, hover lifts to accent border
component_styling.card_marketing: .mk-card / .mk-card-flat / .mk-card-block — white surface, 1px hairline, 14px radius, soft shadow
component_styling.button_console: .cyber-btn — indigo fill, white text, --radius, translateY(-1px) on hover
component_styling.input: surface-inset background, hairline-strong border, focus ring `0 0 0 3px rgb(var(--accent) / 0.18)`
component_styling.badge: mono, 10-11px, rounded, colour from the status mapping
component_styling.table: .data-table — sticky mono micro-label headers on surface-raised, hairline rows, right-aligned numbers

allowed: Pastel glow blobs (.mk-glow) behind hero and CTA content on the marketing surface
Fine grid background (.mk-grid-bg) with a radial mask at the top of marketing pages
Product mockups as pure CSS in .mk-window frames — no bitmap screenshots
Subtle slide-in/rise-in entrance animation with the .stagger-N delays
disallowed: Neon glows, scanlines, glitch text, 3D card tilt (removed from the previous system)
Literal hex values in components — only lib/palette.js and the marketing mock frames carry hex

page_specific_rules.landing: Light scope. Centered hero with one primary CTA, product window mock, hairline-separated feature sections, single pricing block, FAQ accordion, multi-column footer.
page_specific_rules.login: Light scope, single card, OAuth buttons at full width.
page_specific_rules.dashboard: Stat tiles on a 12-column grid, telemetry charts using CHART_COLORS, activity feed with status pills.
page_specific_rules.execution_flow: Vertical lifecycle rail with .timeline-line/.timeline-dot; blocked executions render in --danger.
page_specific_rules.agent_registry: Card grid; each agent card carries a grade badge coloured by gradeColor() and a freeze state that switches to --danger.
page_specific_rules.treasury: Data-heavy. Mono, right-aligned financial columns; stacks use --info and --violet.

accessibility.contrast: Body text is --text-secondary or stronger on its surface in both scopes.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible 2px ring (--ring) on every focusable element via :focus-visible.
accessibility.reduced_motion: index.css disables animations and transitions under prefers-reduced-motion.
accessibility.testids: Every interactive element keeps a data-testid; src/pages/design.smoke.test.js fails the build if a documented hook disappears.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. TOKENS: add or change colours in src/index.css only (both scopes), then mirror in tailwind.config.js if a new Tailwind name is needed.
2. JS CONSUMERS: read colours from src/lib/palette.js for Recharts, SVG and inline styles.
3. SCOPE: wrap marketing routes in `.theme-marketing`; console routes inherit the dark default.
4. VERIFY: `cd frontend && CI=false npm run build && npx craco test --watchAll=false`.
5. PRE-RENDER: keep the inline style block in public/index.html in sync with the light tokens.
6. SCREENSHOTS: re-run verify_frontend_v2.py after visual changes to refresh verification/*.png.
